data.description: Provenance gap: the rival input (cited within the synthesis as response.2#r1-r7) is not among the artifacts exposed at this carry step, so the synthesis's dependencies on it — the convener-verdict conjecture behind the entrance's stand-down, the discriminating checks inside k6, the stand-down-first ordering rejected in j1, and the rivalry side of the framing contest in pB — cannot be re-verified from the exposed material and are carried on the synthesis's own report. A missing view says what can currently be seen, not what happened earlier: this blocks no current action, but it does block any future relitigation of j1 or pB, which should first re-expose the source.
